reuse.why: The new link function reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse and all six link handlers share one guard, but the takeover path re-writes the unlink field reset instead of sharing it with unlinkAccount, and the Fintegra link/download are copied from the Akahu ones.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, and the detach update repeats unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount field list.

placement.why: The guard sits next to the link handlers in accounts/app.ts, the download in sync.ts and the endpoint in server-config.ts, matching where the tree keeps each provider's pieces; a side-effecting unlink inside an 'ensure' guard is a slightly odd home.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps; the only incidental edit is widening DbAccount.account_sync_source to all providers, which is related.

maintainability.why: One shared guard covering every provider is good, but it has accreted the closed-account check and a mutating takeover behind a name that says 'ensure not linked', and the per-provider copies keep growing.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked clears the old account with its own db.updateAccount field list instead of going through the unlinkAccount logic (whose provider-removal step it deliberately skips, but without sharing the reset)

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (Fintegra link vs Akahu link, Fintegra download vs Akahu download, unlink field reset) are open, near-verbatim copies rather than disguised ones.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in accounts/app.ts gains the replaceExistingLink parameter, an upgradingId closed-account branch (step 3) and a replace-and-detach branch (step 4); all six provider link handlers call it
